correctness.rationale: For arbitrary n>=4, each square lies uniquely in a three-position S3 K3,3 coset or a commuting four-position disjoint-transposition square; inclusion-exclusion counts all permissible derangements exactly. The forbidden board rook polynomial is an exact product and the 4-to-1 division counts each corner once. Degree two-cycle counting and closed-four-walk decomposition derive the trace. Two fully independent finite programs (formula and graph-exhaustion) agree for n=4..7, with no finite-to-infinite inference.

value.rationale: The quadrilateral census counts all two-step switch ambiguities in a natural bipartite perfect-matching reconfiguration chain, resolves fundamentally different braid and commuting mechanisms, and determines the first nontrivial closed-walk adjacency moment. These exact all-orders invariants are not routine consequences of the already-known connectedness/degree range and provide a structural statistic for local switch-chain and spectral studies.
